nodes.title: Kick-off meeting with advisor
nodes.desc: Agreed on the topic and a rough twelve-month plan. Left the office genuinely excited, which lasted about a week.

nodes.title: Thesis repo and LaTeX template set up
nodes.desc: One repo for text, code and figures. Compiles to an empty 3-page PDF, and that already felt like progress.

nodes.title: Outline agreed: five chapters
nodes.desc: Intro, methods, results, discussion, conclusions. The shape of the whole thing in one page.

nodes.title: Related work folded into Chapter 1
nodes.desc: Four pages of the literature review became section 1.2, with the gap statement as its closing paragraph.

nodes.title: Chapter 1 — Introduction, first draft
nodes.desc: Eleven pages. Rough, but the argument runs from start to finish without a hole in it.

nodes.title: Pipeline results pulled into the text
nodes.desc: The numbers in the thesis are now produced by one command instead of six notebooks in the right order.

nodes.title: Chapter 2 accepted by advisor
nodes.desc: First chapter to come back with no structural comments. Only typos and one complaint about notation.

nodes.title: Final figure style applied everywhere
nodes.desc: Every figure in the thesis now shares one palette, one font size and one export path.

nodes.title: Chapter 3 signed off
nodes.desc: The results chapter is done. This is the half of the thesis that actually contains new science.

nodes.title: Mid-thesis seminar talk
nodes.desc: Thirty minutes plus questions. Went fine. Two good suggestions about the error bars and one about the outlook.

nodes.title: Advisor feedback, round one
nodes.desc: Six pages of comments on chapters 1 to 3. Harsh on the introduction, generous everywhere else.

nodes.title: Consistent notation across all chapters
nodes.desc: One afternoon with a table of every symbol used. Found four collisions and one symbol defined twice.

nodes.title: Bibliography cleaned up
nodes.desc: 280 entries down to 214. Removed duplicates, fixed the arXiv-only references, normalised journal names.

nodes.title: Search: reviews 2015 to 2025
nodes.desc: Systematic pass over three databases. 180 hits, 40 worth opening, 12 worth reading properly.

nodes.title: Zotero library and tagging scheme
nodes.desc: Tags by method, system and whether the paper actually reports a negative result.

nodes.title: Read the twelve core papers
nodes.desc: One page of notes each, always answering the same three questions so they can be compared later.

nodes.title: Summary table of existing methods
nodes.desc: Methods against assumptions. Two columns turned out to be empty, which is where the thesis lives.

nodes.title: Found the gap: nobody compares X under Y
nodes.desc: The sentence the whole thesis hangs on. Took five weeks of reading to be able to write one line.

nodes.title: Drafted four pages of related work
nodes.desc: Written as an argument that ends at the gap, rather than as a list of what everyone did.

nodes.title: Scaffold the package and environment
nodes.desc: A pinned environment and an installable package, so results can be reproduced on the cluster.

nodes.title: Data loader for the raw dataset
nodes.desc: Handles the three file formats the group has accumulated and validates shapes on the way in.

nodes.title: First simulation run that finishes
nodes.desc: Ran overnight, produced plausible-looking output. Celebrated slightly too early, as it turned out.

nodes.title: It was wrong: off-by-one in the time index
nodes.desc: Ten days lost. Every figure produced before this date is garbage. Now there is a regression test for it.

nodes.title: Unit tests for the core solver
nodes.desc: Analytic limits where the answer is known. Cheap insurance, bought exactly one week too late.

nodes.title: Batch runs on the cluster
nodes.desc: 240 jobs across the parameter sweep, about eleven hours of wall time and one failed node.

nodes.title: Results reproduce the reference paper
nodes.desc: Within error bars on all four benchmark points. The pipeline can now be trusted with new physics.

nodes.title: Colour-blind-safe palette
nodes.desc: Checked with a simulator for all three common types. Also survives being printed in greyscale.

nodes.title: Reusable matplotlib style file
nodes.desc: Fonts, sizes and margins in one place, matched to the LaTeX body text so nothing is rescaled.

nodes.title: Figure 3: the phase diagram
nodes.desc: The one figure people will remember from the thesis. Redrawn four times before it was legible.

nodes.title: Figure 5: convergence panel
nodes.desc: Four panels sharing axes, showing the solver converges in every regime that is claimed.

nodes.title: Regenerated every figure at 600 dpi
nodes.desc: One command rebuilds all seventeen figures from raw data. No more hand-edited PDFs.

nodes.title: Try rewriting the intro as a story
nodes.desc: Start from the puzzle rather than the field, and let the literature arrive when it is needed.

nodes.title: Dropped: advisor prefers the classic structure
nodes.desc: Not wasted. Two paragraphs survived and are now the best-written part of section 1.2.

nodes.title: Outline of the methods chapter
nodes.desc: Model, approximations, numerical scheme, validation. In that order, each section earning the next.

nodes.title: Write the model section
nodes.desc: Every assumption stated explicitly, including the two that are usually left implicit in the field.

nodes.title: Derivation appendix
nodes.desc: Six pages of algebra moved out of the main text so the chapter stays readable.

nodes.title: Rewrote 2.3 after advisor comments
nodes.desc: The approximation was justified in the wrong order: consequences first, then the reason.

nodes.title: Added the pseudo-code box
nodes.desc: Half a page that replaced two pages of prose describing the same loop.

nodes.title: Proofread and fixed all references
nodes.desc: Every equation reference checked by hand after the great renumbering incident.

nodes.title: Decide which results make the cut
nodes.desc: Three of the seven result sets tell the story. The rest go to the appendix or nowhere.

nodes.title: Write results section 3.1
nodes.desc: The main claim of the thesis, stated with its evidence in under four pages.

nodes.title: Section 3.2 drafted
nodes.desc: The parameter sweep. Harder to write than expected because the trend reverses twice.

nodes.title: Uncertainties folded into the chapter
nodes.desc: Every number in Chapter 3 now carries an uncertainty that was computed rather than guessed.

nodes.title: Cut three pages that went nowhere
nodes.desc: A whole subsection deleted. Painful, and the chapter is clearly better without it.

nodes.title: Final pass on Chapter 3
nodes.desc: Read aloud start to finish. Fixed the six sentences that could not be said in one breath.

nodes.title: Work out what the error bars mean
nodes.desc: The old bars mixed statistical scatter with a systematic offset. They were not comparable.

nodes.title: Bootstrap over the random seeds
nodes.desc: 2000 resamples per point. Slow, but it needs to run exactly once per result set.

nodes.title: Re-ran every number in the chapter
nodes.desc: Two conclusions got weaker, one got stronger. None of them flipped, which was a relief.

nodes.title: Idea: redo the fits with a Bayesian model
nodes.desc: Suggested at the seminar. Would give proper posteriors instead of least squares and hand-waving.

nodes.title: Prototype in PyMC
nodes.desc: Works on the toy problem. Sampling the full model takes nine hours and occasionally diverges.

nodes.title: Dropped: same conclusion, three weeks of compute
nodes.desc: The posteriors agree with the bootstrap to two digits. Worth knowing, not worth a chapter.

nodes.title: Outline of the discussion
nodes.desc: What the results mean, where they disagree with the field, and what they cannot settle.

nodes.title: Compare against the three competing approaches
nodes.desc: Honest about the one case where the competing method is faster and gives the same answer.

nodes.title: Write the limitations section
nodes.desc: Four limitations, each with a sentence on what it would take to remove it.

nodes.title: Draft the outlook paragraph
nodes.desc: Two concrete experiments that would test the prediction, both doable by the group next year.

nodes.title: Rework 4.2 after the group meeting
nodes.desc: The comparison reads as defensive. It should just state the trade-off and move on.

nodes.title: Decide which tables belong in the text
nodes.desc: Two summary tables in Chapter 4, the full parameter listings go to the appendix.

nodes.title: Generate tables from the result files
nodes.desc: LaTeX tables written directly by the pipeline, so they can never drift from the data again.

nodes.title: Table 4.1 formatting
nodes.desc: Aligned on the decimal point, significant digits matched to the uncertainties.

nodes.title: Chapter 5 — Conclusions
nodes.desc: Short. Three pages that say what was found, what it changes, and what comes next.

nodes.title: Full read-through and proofread
nodes.desc: Printed, on paper, with a red pen and no computer nearby.

nodes.title: Send the complete draft to the advisor
nodes.desc: The last big handover before submission. Expect one more round of comments after it.

nodes.title: Submit
nodes.desc: Upload, sign, hand in the printed copies. Then do not look at it again for a month.
